title: The automorphism group conjecture for the substructure ordering of finite directed graphs
statement:
Let $\mathcal{D}$ be the partial order of finite directed graphs under the substructure relation $\sqsubseteq$. Let $\operatorname{Aut}\mathcal{D}$ denote its automorphism group, and let $\mathcal{C}$ be the subgroup generated by the explicitly constructed automorphisms $\varphi_i$, whose structure is

$$
\mathcal{C}\cong(\mathbb{Z}_2^4\times S_4)\rtimes_{\alpha}\mathbb{Z}_2.
$$

Here $S_4$ is the symmetric group on $\{A,B,C,D\}$, and $\alpha$ is defined by

$$
\alpha(0)=\operatorname{id},\qquad \alpha(1):(p,q,r,s,\pi)\mapsto(q,p,s,r,(BC)\pi(BC)).
$$

**The automorphism group conjecture.**

$$
\operatorname{Aut}\mathcal{D}\cong\mathcal{C}\cong(\mathbb{Z}_2^4\times S_4)\rtimes_{\alpha}\mathbb{Z}_2.
$$

Thus the automorphism group of the substructure ordering would have exactly $768$ elements, and the conjecture asserts that the constructed subgroup contains all automorphisms of the partial order. The paper proves the stated structure of $\mathcal{C}$ but does not prove that no additional automorphisms exist.
source_name: Fanni K. Nedényi and Ádám Kunos, “On the Automorphism Group of the Substructure Ordering of Finite Directed Graphs”, arXiv:2209.05820 (2022).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2209.05820

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of September 2022).
